requirement: The system shall refuse to enroll a student in a course when they have not completed that course's listed prerequisites.
The system shall compute a student's final grade for a course from the weighted mark of each assessment component and translate it to a letter grade using the faculty scale.
The student selects a course from the catalogue; the system checks capacity and prerequisites and, if accepted, records the enrolment.
The examiner enters a mark for each student in a submitted assignment; the system validates the mark is within the permitted range and saves it.
As a student, I want to see my current marks per course so that I know how I am tracking before the final exam.
As a department administrator, I want to confirm final results for a course so that grades are released to students and locked against further edits.
A student may not enrol in more than five courses in a single term, and may not enrol in two courses with overlapping timetabled sessions.
Every change to a student's recorded mark must be logged with the original value, the new value, the editor and a timestamp.
The enrolment table shall ensure a student is not enrolled in the same course twice in the same term, and that the enrolment status is one of the defined values.
code:
-- enrolment core table for the student system
CREATE TABLE enrolment (
    enrolment_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id     VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    course_code    VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    term           VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    enrolled_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT enrolment_student_fk FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES student(student_id),
    CONSTRAINT enrolment_course_fk  FOREIGN KEY (course_code) REFERENCES course(course_code),
    CONSTRAINT enrolment_no_duplicate UNIQUE (student_id, course_code, term),
    CONSTRAINT enrolment_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('ENROLLED','WITHDRAWN','COMPLETED','FAILED')),
    CONSTRAINT enrolled_at_not_null CHECK (enrolled_at IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX enrolment_course_idx ON enrolment (course_code, term, status);
hard_negatives:
-- marks table storing raw and moderated values
CREATE TABLE assignment_mark (
    mark_id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    enrolment_id     BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    component_code   VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    percent_value    NUMERIC(5,2)  NOT NULL,
    moderated        BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT mark_enrolment_fk FOREIGN KEY (enrolment_id) REFERENCES enrolment(enrolment_id),
    CONSTRAINT mark_percent_range CHECK (percent_value BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);
-- course catalogue table
CREATE TABLE course (
    course_code    VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,
    title          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    credits        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    capacity       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    faculty_code   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT course_credits_positive CHECK (credits > 0),
    CONSTRAINT course_capacity_positive CHECK (capacity > 0)
);

requirement: Only the assigned examiner or the department head may change a mark, and only while the course's results are not yet confirmed.
The grade export job shall write one CSV row per enrolled student per course with their final percentage and letter grade, and skip students who withdrew.
